message.text: Searching for the backend function that handles the SignIn RPC and its file path.
I'll locate the backend handler for the SignIn RPC.
The SignIn RPC is handled by `APIV1Service.SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`.

q04.
APIV1Service.SignIn — server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go

`AuthService.SignIn` is implemented as `func (s *APIV1Service) SignIn` in `server/router/api/v1/auth_service.go`. The Connect adapter in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` forwards to that same method.
